# Purpose
The provided file is a GitHub Actions workflow configuration file written in YAML, designed to automate the process of running CodeQL analysis on a codebase. The workflow is triggered by events such as pushes and pull requests to the 'main' branch, as well as on a scheduled basis every Monday at 16:10. It defines a job named "Analyze" that runs on the latest Ubuntu environment, with permissions to write security events. The job includes steps to check out the repository, set up Java Development Kit (JDK) version 17 using the Temurin distribution, and initialize CodeQL for scanning Java code. The workflow is configured to compile only the main sources, excluding test sources, and then perform a CodeQL analysis to identify security vulnerabilities and maintainability issues in the codebase.
